PF2R7EX1 now excludes the declared nonimmersed single-ramified-row stratum; its old extra-image continuation is superseded unless a proof defect is identified. PF2OMIT4 separates the normalized different from squared inverse-order index factors: retain f weights and do not read primitive-coordinate collisions as ramification or lost sheets. For an off-branch singleton, require the actual inverse coefficient staircase and discriminant order>=(d-1)*(d-2); degree6 requires order20, and its single-e2f1 index factor has order>=10. These are necessary constraints; the actual normalized algebra and image equations are still needed. PF2R7EX2 now removes finality from the scoped two-cusp exclusion. The remaining conic targets are the immersed polynomial-quartic contact gate and special multiple-derivative-root reciprocal profiles; normal-r7 passport completeness is still not automatic. PF2OMIT5 now excludes the entire degree6 single e2,f1 ramified-prime gap21 stratum without source finality. That closes its immersed quartic and multiple-root reciprocal continuations. Audit the entire-ramification hypothesis before applying this result to a terminal passport; unrestricted singleton-zero properness and other ramification patterns still require the complete actual normalization ledger. PF2R7QALL1/PF2R7QEX1 now exclude the whole quartic-contact family, leaving only the immersed reciprocal cubic with a finite exact double p_prime root in the declared single-ramified-prime setting. PF2OMIT6 now fixes every residual r7 residue degree to1 and supplies all pointwise source-length and singleton branch rules. Determine actual image equations and the exceptional value, rather than treating f as free or continuing the single-prime reciprocal branch already excluded by PF2OMIT5. At an off-branch singleton with sole unramified pole order p, enforce leading order5p, raw discriminant order>=20p and index factor order>=10p. PF2OMIT7 fixes the residual excess-one point as a regular ordinary cusp and gives all singleton radial rows, charts, fibre lengths and canonical vectors. For an actual image B locate its unique common derivative root and require nonzero second/third jet determinant. Retain the explicit radial/strict node intersections after target blowup; only the corresponding original targetA2 projection is forbidden. Complete the global affine image equations and attachment data rather than reclassifying those resolved local algebras. PF2OMIT8 requires the actual residual image pair to support connected S6 monodromy with one2-cycle over C and one2/3-cycle over B. The source field has no proper intermediate field; a composite-degree tower or the discriminant sign double cover is not a replacement normalization. Retain the unramified omitted prime even when its distinct image has identity inertia. Candidate equations and their actual global complement relations are still required.

## WORK-PLANE-EVEN-OMISSION-20261114

**Repair the omitted-row gap in the historical normal-even Stein exclusion**

**Disposition:** archived-programme. **Kind:** research. **Compute class:** none.

**Next step:** Classify all reconstruction-pole primes in a global normal algebra, including e1 rows. For r10 reconcile the required extra unramified prime with its actual image and infinity attachment. Re-establish r6/r8 necessary-locus exhaustion allowing all omitted rows before promoting restricted cusp braid certificates. For an actual plane candidate, PF2OMIT3 replaces an arbitrary resolvent by a source-finite primitive inverse: certify output monicity in the complementary source coordinate and the coefficient unit ideal, factor its leading coefficient for every omission image, and use specialization degree for exact aggregate fibre lengths. The remaining immersed r7 inverse leading coefficient needs an image factor beyond the ramified curve. Individual e,f and exceptional local points still require normalized residual data; no inverse is inferred from a terminal passport alone. PF2OMIT4 separates the normalized different from squared inverse-order index factors: retain f weights and do not read primitive-coordinate collisions as ramification or lost sheets. For an off-branch singleton, require the actual inverse coefficient staircase and discriminant order>=(d-1)*(d-2); degree6 requires order20, and its single-e2f1 index factor has order>=10. The immersed r7 ledger has five generic image groupings, of which only three admit an off-branch singleton, requiring three or four nonproper target components. These are necessary constraints; the actual normalized algebra and image equations are still needed. PF2OMIT5 now excludes the entire degree6 single e2,f1 ramified-prime gap21 stratum without source finality. That closes its immersed quartic and multiple-root reciprocal continuations. Audit the entire-ramification hypothesis before applying this result to a terminal passport; unrestricted singleton-zero properness and other ramification patterns still require the complete actual normalization ledger. PF2OMIT6 now fixes every residual r7 residue degree to1 and supplies all pointwise source-length and singleton branch rules. Determine actual image equations and the exceptional value, rather than treating f as free or continuing the single-prime reciprocal branch already excluded by PF2OMIT5. At an off-branch singleton with sole unramified pole order p, enforce leading order5p, raw discriminant order>=20p and index factor order>=10p. PF2OMIT7 fixes the residual excess-one point as a regular ordinary cusp and gives all singleton radial rows, charts, fibre lengths and canonical vectors. For an actual image B locate its unique common derivative root and require nonzero second/third jet determinant. Retain the explicit radial/strict node intersections after target blowup; only the corresponding original targetA2 projection is forbidden. Complete the global affine image equations and attachment data rather than reclassifying those resolved local algebras. PF2OMIT8 requires the actual residual image pair to support connected S6 monodromy with one2-cycle over C and one2/3-cycle over B. The source field has no proper intermediate field; a composite-degree tower or the discriminant sign double cover is not a replacement normalization. Retain the unramified omitted prime even when its distinct image has identity inertia. Candidate equations and their actual global complement relations are still required.

**Completion evidence:** A complete omitted-divisor ledger or a replacement global argument proves the claimed entire even-row exclusion; a numerical repair alone proves neither realization nor exclusion.

**Prerequisites and boundary:** Exact implicit differences, saturated loci and restricted braid certificates remain retained. The terminal passport only locates ramification, and P2 common-point structure requires transport to the blown-up target.
